items.title: 240 UK taxpayers made more than $1.3 million each from crypto holdings in fiscal 2025
items.summary: For the first time, the U.K.'s tax office broke out crypto capital gains figures, showing 17,600 people reported $1.87 billion in profits during the 2024-2025 tax year.

items.title: Bitcoin tests its largest supply wall at $80,000, near ETF holders’ average price
items.summary: Bitcoin is testing its largest supply cluster alongside the key 50-week moving average.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies above $79,000 as ETF inflows hit longest streak since April
items.summary: BTC held its ground Thursday as spot bitcoin ETFs logged an eighth straight day of net inflows, while altcoins drifted lower across the board.

items.title: BlackRock's Mitchnick says macro case for bitcoin is strengthening after record trading in positive week
items.summary: BlackRock's head of digital assets shared his outlook for bitcoin after the company's spot BTC ETF, IBIT, hit record volume for a positive week.
